role.title: How will you use SIAB?
role.subtitle: This sets up your account. You can change it later in Settings, but not casually.
role.buyerDescription: Browse the marketplace, message sellers, make offers and place orders.
role.sellerDescription: Open your own stall, list products, and get two AI assistants of your own.
role.stallNameHint: This is the name buyers will see. You cannot open a seller account without one.
role.stallNameRequired: Please choose a stall name to continue.
role.stallNameTaken: That stall name is taken. Try another.

score.label: SIAB score
score.explainBody: Everyone starts at 100. After an order is completed, the buyer and the seller each choose to add 5, take away 5, or skip. It is the only rating on SIAB.
score.diamondPerk: Diamond members receive special treatment from SIAB.
score.rated: Thank you. Your rating has been recorded.
score.alreadyRated: You have already rated this order.

handover.waitingOnSeller: Waiting for the seller to confirm.
handover.bothConfirmed: Both sides confirmed. You can now rate each other.
handover.explain: Both of you must confirm before either can give a rating.

coworkerExamples.compare: How do my prices compare to similar listings?

safety.meetingBody: Choose a public place, bring someone with you if you can, and check the item before paying. SIAB is not a delivery company and is not part of what happens when you meet.
